basic_details.job_title: IISc Clinical Psychologist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit for the Clinical Psychologist position is 52 Years as on the last date of receipt of the application. Age relaxation as per GoI norms (if applicable) will be extended.

qualification.details: The candidate must be a citizen of India.

salary_details.details: An annual increment of up to 10% is permissible with a maximum of 4 such revisions, subject to the committee’s recommendation and approval by the Competent Authority.

selection_process: Shortlisted candidates will be called for Interview.
how_to_apply: Go to the official online application portal at IISc Temporary Positions Portal.
Read the instructions carefully and fill out the application form with correct details.
Attach the required certificates in support of age, category, qualification, marks, and experience.
Submit the online application on or before 29.10.2026.
Keep a printout of the online submitted application form for future reference.
important_instructions: Engagement is purely temporary on a contract basis, initially for a period of one year and renewable annually up to a maximum duration of five years. No hardcopy submission of the online submitted application is accepted. In case the interview is held in person, no TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview. Selection for the post does not entitle any claim whatsoever of permanency or regularization against any regular post. No claim for any service benefits like PF, Pension, Seniority & Promotion etc. from this contract appointment will be admissible. The contract can be terminated at any time by giving one month’s notice, by either side. No accommodation will be provided on the Institute campus during the course of stay.

faq.question: Q1. What is IISc Clinical Psychologist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by the Indian Institute of Science (IISc) to fill 3 vacancies for Clinical Psychologist positions at the Institute's Wellness Centre on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IISc Clinical Psychologist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available, divided into Unreserved (02) and OBC (01) categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IISc Clinical Psychologist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for IISc Clinical Psychologist?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Phil./MSc./Psy.D in Clinical Psychology with a minimum of 2 years of post-experience in counselling and support, along with mandatory RCI registration for M.Phil. holders.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IISc Clinical Psychologist?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 52 years as on the last date of receipt of the application, with age relaxation applicable as per GoI norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IISc Clinical Psychologist?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for IISc Clinical Psychologist posts?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official portal link provided in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IISc Clinical Psychologist?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly remuneration for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly remuneration of Rs. 47,000/- + HRA.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, engagement is purely temporary on a contract basis initially for one year, renewable up to a maximum duration of five years, and does not entitle any claim for permanency.
